title_en: Selection of 2027 DN Cultural Foundation Scholars, College of Engineering
summary: Undergraduate students currently enrolled who are interested in production and manufacturing and who meet the GPA and other requirements may apply for the 2027 DN Cultural Foundation Scholarship. Applicants must email the recommendation list, the foundation application form, a transcript, a certificate of enrollment and the personal information consent forms to the department office by Wednesday, 4 November 2026. The department office's email address is given in the original notice.
applies_to: Optional (apply if interested). Open to undergraduate students currently enrolled who are interested in the production and manufacturing field, from any department or school. Applicants must have a grade point average of at least 3.3/4.3 in the previous semester, must have at least two semesters of study remaining, and must not have been selected for this scholarship before. Students who are selected must attend the award ceremony and the opening ceremony.

translation:
Selection of 2027 DN Cultural Foundation Scholars, College of Engineering

The College of Engineering will select 2027 DN Cultural Foundation scholars as follows. Interested students are invited to apply.

A. Number of recommendations: No limit. ※ The College of Engineering plans to recommend up to 15 students, and the foundation plans to select about 5.

B. Recommendation (selection) requirements
1) Undergraduate students currently enrolled who are interested in the production and manufacturing field. ※ No restriction by department or school.
2) A grade point average of 3.3/4.3 or higher in the previous semester, with at least two semesters of study remaining.
3) Students who have not previously been selected for this scholarship.

C. Scholarship amount: Study encouragement grant of KRW 4,000,000 per year (paid as KRW 400,000 per month for 10 months, March to December 2027).
※ May be received together with scholarships from other organisations.

D. Selection procedure
1) Application deadline and method: Submit one copy each of the [attached] Excel recommendation list, the scholarship application form (foundation form), a transcript (as of Spring 2026), a certificate of enrollment, and the consent forms for the collection, use and provision of personal information (foundation and university) to the department office by email by Wednesday, 4 November 2026. (The email address is given in the original notice.)
※ If more students apply than the College of Engineering's recommendation quota (15), applicants who meet the basic eligibility requirements will be evaluated by a combined score of grades and interest in the production and manufacturing field. In the event of a tie, recipients will be selected by previous-semester GPA, then by credits completed in the previous semester.
2) College of Engineering document review and first-round selection of recommended students: during November 2026.
3) Foundation document review and selection of scholars: during December 2026.

E. Notes
1) Students recommended by the College of Engineering may not be finally selected as scholars.
2) Recommended students are asked to familiarise themselves with the 'main activities and conditions for maintaining scholarship payment' in the guide.
3) Final selection results will be announced during December 2026 through the foundation's selection process.
4) Students selected as scholars must attend the award ceremony (February 2027) and the opening ceremony [시무식] (November 2027).

Attachments
1. Foundation official letter and guide, 1 copy.
2. Forms for the documents to be submitted, 1 copy each.
3. Recommendation list form, 1 copy.

Attached files (4):
- DN문화재단 장학생 모집 안내문.docx (DN Cultural Foundation scholarship recruitment guide, 47 KB)
- DN문화재단 장학생 지원 신청서 및 동의서(양식).docx (DN Cultural Foundation scholarship application form and consent form, 58 KB)
- 개인정보 수집 이용 및 제공 동의서(공대).hwp (Consent form for collection, use and provision of personal information, College of Engineering, 79 KB)
- 장학생 추천명단.xlsx (Scholarship recommendation list, 13 KB)
